facts.anchor: a softness to the chignon her hair had been pinned into

facts.fact: 他想象她坐在伦敦某个文学沙龙里跟人辩论。
facts.anchor: He could imagine her in some literary salon in London

facts.fact: 现实里她穿着那身层叠长裙，走两步就要绊一下。
facts.anchor: The real woman could barely walk without tripping over the layered skirts

facts.fact: 他的目光停在她那条旧皮腰带上。
facts.anchor: His gaze lingered on her familiar leather belt

facts.fact: 她拍了拍腰间那只八卦镜，像是要靠这些行头定心。

facts.fact: 他用粤语背了一句情诗：见过大海，别的水就入不了眼。
facts.anchor: “No other waters can impress me, for I have seen the ocean,” Archie said in Cantonese

facts.fact: 那句话的声调他一个错处都没犯。
facts.anchor: He hadn’t made a single misstep in his inflection.

facts.fact: 她板着脸，耳朵却整个红了。

facts.fact: 这天是跑马地马场的九周年纪念日。
facts.anchor: It was the ninth anniversary of the Happy Valley racecourse

facts.fact: 主办方特地订造了两尊石狮子，立在赛道终点当界线。
facts.anchor: They had even commissioned two stone guardian lions

facts.fact: 她说石狮子不该面对面，守护的东西该朝外对着入口。
facts.anchor: “The lions should not be facing each other.

facts.fact: 那句话一出口他就知道说错了。
facts.anchor: It was the wrong thing to say

facts.fact: 为了赔罪，他提议去押一注马。
facts.anchor: he proposed they place a bet on a horse

facts.fact: 她一只手掌平贴在他嘴上，把话截断。
facts.anchor: Miss Kim put a flat hand over his mouth

facts.fact: 她从来没问过他的年薪，也没问过他家里夏天住哪儿。
facts.anchor: She had never once asked his annual income

facts.fact: 轮到他下注时，脱口而出的还是她。
facts.anchor: “She really is something.”

facts.fact: 庄家报出五十比一的赔率，还问他确不确定。
facts.anchor: “Fifty-to-one odds, sir, are you certain?”

facts.fact: 他转头去看马，撞上了另一个人，随后头晕、视线发暗。
facts.anchor: he crashed into another person

facts.fact: 他记得的最后一件事就是那一撞之后有人喊他起来。
facts.anchor: That was the last thing he remembered.
